**Available Scholarships**

• **Government Scholarship**: For family income below Rs. 2.5 Lakhs (tuition fee waiver)
• **Merit Scholarship**: CGPA 9.0+ (Rs. 10,000/semester)
• **Minority Scholarship**: For minority community students
• **SC/ST Scholarship**: Full tuition fee (through government portal)

Apply at the beginning of the academic year.

**How to Apply**

• **Government/Minority/SC-ST**: Apply through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
• **Merit Scholarship**: Apply through college office with marks card
• Apply at **beginning** of academic year
• Submit **income certificate** if required
• Forms available at admin office

**Scholarship Eligibility**

1. **Government**: Family income below Rs. 2.5 Lakhs, Indian resident
2. **Merit**: CGPA 9.0 or above, no backlogs
3. **Minority**: Belonging to minority community with income proof
4. **SC/ST**: Valid caste certificate required

Maintain required CGPA throughout the course.

**Scholarship Rules**

• Apply at **beginning** of academic year
• Maintain required **CGPA** to continue
��� Submit **income certificate** renewed annually
• **Renew** every semester with progress reports
• Maintain **75%+ attendance**
• Any backlogs may affect renewal
